info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Payment Initiation Review API
info.description: The Payment Initiation Review API facilitates the submission of reviews related to payment initiation processes within banking services. This endpoint allows users to provide feedback on their payment experiences, which can help improve service quality and customer satisfaction. Typical consumers include bank customers and financial institutions aiming to enhance their payment systems based on user input. By gathering insights through these reviews, organizations can effectively address pain points and refine their offerings.

post.summary: Initiate a review for the payment
post.description: This endpoint allows users to initiate a review for a specific payment identified by PAY-300045. It is essential for ensuring that customer feedback is collected and helps in improving service quality.
